name: J-Sei Meals on Wheels
description: J-Sei, a Japanese American community center in Emeryville, delivers hot Japanese-style lunches to seniors in parts of Alameda and Contra Costa counties, designed with a registered dietitian to meet seniors' nutritional needs.
fullDescription: J-Sei, a Japanese American community center in Emeryville, delivers hot Japanese-style lunches to seniors in parts of Alameda and Contra Costa counties, designed with a registered dietitian to meet seniors' nutritional needs.
whatTheyOffer:
- Hot Japanese-style lunches delivered to your home
- Meals designed with a registered dietitian (low-sugar, low-sodium, heart-conscious)
- Voluntary contribution of $5/meal for seniors 60+
- Monthly pantry grocery delivery for enrolled home-delivered meal clients
- Thursday congregate lunch at J-Sei in Emeryville (reserve 2 days ahead)
howToGetIt: Call Sianne Susbilla, Nutrition Services Manager, at 510-654-4000 ext. 105 or email sianne@j-sei.org. You must be 60+, have some difficulty shopping, cooking, or leaving home, live within the delivery area, and complete a home visit and assessment.
keywords: J-Sei, Japanese meals, Asian senior, culturally appropriate, home delivered meals, senior food, Alameda County, Contra Costa, Emeryville, ethnic food
